(2)

(2)

(4)

A1: $y = 1 \pm 2\sqrt{3}$, cao cso.

Official notes (completeness pass):

- Aliter Way 2: $(x+2)^2+(y-1)^2=16$, centre $(x_1,y_1)=(-2,1)$ and radius $r=4$. $d_1=\sqrt{4^2-2^2}=\sqrt{12}$ M1 (Applying $\sqrt{\text{their } r^2-|\text{their } x_1|^2}$) A1 aef ($\sqrt{12}$).
